name: Café Pizzeria Capricorno
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Café Pizzeria Capricorno in Tirol!**

Indulge in authentic Italian flavors right in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy café offers a perfect blend of traditional Austrian charm and Mediterranean cuisine, making it the ideal spot for a relaxed break or a delicious meal.

Savor our freshly baked **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy on the outside and fluffy inside, served with a generous drizzle of apricot jam and powdered sugar. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Melange** or a frothy **Eiskaffee** for the ultimate treat.

For pizza lovers, our wood-fired ovens bring you mouthwatering classics like **Margherita**, **Diavola**, and **Prosciutto e Funghi**, all made with the finest ingredients. Don’t miss our seasonal specialties, crafted with love and local produce.

Whether you’re exploring **Innsbruck**, taking a scenic hike in the **Zillertal**, or simply enjoying the alpine views, Café Pizzeria Capricorno is your go-to destination for a taste of Italy in Tirol.

**Come and visit us—your taste buds will thank you!**
